title: Made in Abyss
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Orphan Riko lives in Orth, a town ringing an enormous pit called the Abyss, where explorers recover relics but ascending brings a deadly curse. She finds Reg, a robot boy, and after a message suggests her legendary mother waits at the bottom, they descend together into ever more lethal layers.
life_message: A good life means following wonder and love into the unknown, at any cost.

content.note: Graphic injury, mutilation and cruel experiments involving children (AniList Gore 70%, Body Horror 84%; Wikipedia dark fantasy and 'Comics about cannibalism' categories, reviewer calls it 'brutal').
Survival horror with children facing maiming and death (AniList Survival 97%, Body Horror; Wikipedia).
Child characters drawn nude and toilet humor; MangaDex 'suggestive' (to verify).
Despair, trauma and a mercy-killing request (to verify).
Running away to danger; eating wild creatures.
